correctness.rationale: For n>=7, the two neighborhood-center shore subcomplexes intersect in exactly G_n. Each collapses to the Alexander dual of Ind(C_n); because the latter dual contains the full 2-skeleton, it is simply connected. Classical integral cycle independence homotopy and combinatorial Alexander duality show one free homology degree; the Hurewicz and homological Whitehead theorems give a wedge of spheres. Maps from the graph intersection to simply connected halves are null, so the homotopy pushout splits as A vee B vee suspension(G_n). Its cycle rank is n^2-4n+1. Exact direct mod-two checks for n=7,...,11 agree but are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The canonical removal of a Hamiltonian 2-factor from a complete bipartite graph is a motivated next case beyond matching deletion. The result gives a complete integral (unsuspended) homotopy type for every n>=7, revealing two or four higher spheres at a three-periodic dimension in addition to the quadratic two-sphere term. The nullhomotopic two-shore gluing is structural and is not supplied by the known periodic cycle-independence ranks alone.
